verdict.rationale: The Gmail API is versioned: its documented REST endpoint carries an explicit version segment (gmail/v1). The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle or migration guarantees, so only half the story is evidenced, and only through the endpoint path. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle and support timelines, changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration of versioning stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
